name: TheDawn

components.pose: Slow, solemn ascent: she hovers upright just above the cracked glass, weightless, rising gently with arms lowered slightly away from her sides and palms open, shadows unfurling from her shoulders like folded wings; the dawn light behind her; eyes opening and looking straight to the camera with a calm, newborn, commanding gaze; full figure from head to toe visible.
components.headwear: a tall circlet of {{METAL}} filigree set with a single {{GEM}} stone at the brow, fine {{METAL}} chains swept back through her hair
components.jewelry: layered {{METAL}} bone-and-moon necklaces set with {{GEM}} stones, long drop earrings, bangles stacked on both wrists
components.effects: Threads of {{MAGIC}} shadow rise from the glowing seams of the glass and spiral around her, shards of black glass and drifting ash hanging in the air as they fall back to the crater, a faint violet halo behind her.

notes: THE DAWN: the sister rising from the Sundering in her element's homeland - first look at her territory. Her dragon is not yet bound, so no companion; native creatures instead. Rise speed and energy differ per sister.
